claims.statement: The primitive keeps native checkbox and radio semantics and uses the switch role only for switch intent.
Selection state transitions settle immediately when reduced motion is requested.
Invalid state exposes an alert and associates it with the native control.
With no label the control renders no copy element and takes its accessible name from aria-label, never a dangling aria-labelledby.
A switch thumb tracks the pointer 1:1 during a horizontal drag, commits by release position rather than by tap, and abandons the gesture on pointercancel.
Attaching the drag gesture does not break tap activation through the native control.

component.purpose: Provide native selection semantics with a shared visual and motion grammar.
component.title: SelectionControl

states.description: A checked checkbox communicates persistent preference.
Checkbox, switch, radio, and invalid states share geometry and focus behavior.
A bare switch carries no copy, so a host row can own the labelling without duplicating it.
The indicator sits on the trailing edge for settings-row conventions.
Pointer activation still toggles through the native control after the drag gesture is attached.
